content.Drug-eluting stent placement results: PREMIER registry data showed outcomes related to catastrophic stent thrombosis after coronary stenting.
content.Antitumor effects: sirolimus-eluting stents were shown to limit restenosis after coronary artery stenting.
content.Antiplatelet therapy: importance in stent thrombosis prevention. Various trials and meta-analyses discussed outcomes with different antiplatelet therapies for stenting and acute coronary syndromes.
